in_hebrew.name: Reg
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Reg הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek 'regein', meaning 'to rule' or 'to reign'. This name was borne by several saints and early Christian figures, including Saint Regulus of Scotland and Saint Reginald of Prague. In Christian symbolism, the name Reg can represent spiritual leadership and a strong commitment to one's beliefs.
